g.font-family: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
g.text: I am Bagas, an IT student at Gunadarma University
(started in 2024). I like figuring out how things
work and making them a bit better, whether it is
a workflow, a tool, or a website.
I mostly learn by doing. I run a small homelab
at home, use AdGuard Home and Pi-hole on my
network, and have tried a few Linux distros
I am also curious about how AI tools fit into
everyday work. I do some design in Figma and
Canva, and I like building small interactive
websites, like the ones for my course
